Then there is the genuinely terrifying: Throbbing Gristle, The Body, or Scott Walker's The Drift. This 2006 album from the singer-songwriter is truly upsetting. On it, Walker explores

items.title: Review: Who Is María Corina Machado?
items.summary: The Venezuelan opposition leader returned home from exile to a country firmly under American control. How are her relations with Washington?

items.title: Review: BYD’s Korea Expansion Challenges Hyundai Dominance on Home Turf
items.summary: When Lee Seongdong decided to replace his 2016 Chevrolet Spark in April, a two-year wait for Hyundai Motor Co.’s Casper Electric was already pushing him toward BYD Co.’s Dolphin. He was so impressed by the feature-rich ride that he signed a contract on the spot.

items.title: Review: U.S. measles cases more than double what they were last year as outbreak spreads
items.summary: Pennsylvania is the worst hit state, with at least 1,338 cases of measles confirmed in 44 counties so far this year, according to the Pennsylvania Department of Health.

items.title: Review: A YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo and thinks he found the cause of crackgate
items.summary: Social media and the iPhone Duo subreddit are filled with reports of Apple's foldable failing quickly and in spectacular fashion.
